label: GL.iNet Spitz AX 5G NR router (GL-X3000)
description: GL.iNet Spitz AX (GL-X3000) is a dual-SIM Wi-Fi 6 5G router built on a Quectel RM520N-GL module (5G sub-6, 2.4 Gbps downlink in SA). One 2.5 Gigabit Ethernet WAN port, one Gigabit LAN port and Wi-Fi 6 at 574 + 2402 Mbps; the 5G uplink is carried as the Ethernet-class interface wan5g.
